items.title: Suno brings its gen AI music to iMessage
items.excerpt: Suno added an iMessage keyboard extension that lets iPhone users generate a ~30-second AI song from a text or voice prompt without leaving Messages, alongside a new Mashup feature that fuses any two tracks. It pushes prompt-to-song generation into an everyday, conversational surface.

items.title: AI's new USB port: what the MCP standard means for the music industry
items.excerpt: Model Context Protocol (MCP) is emerging as the connective 'USB port' that lets music-industry platforms wire their catalogues and data directly into ChatGPT, Claude and other AI assistants, so creators and teams can query many tools at once. It signals how AI music workflows will plug together rather than live in silos.

items.title: AI-generated tracks now account for more than 50% of Deezer's uploads
items.excerpt: Deezer says fully AI-generated music now makes up more than half of daily uploads, averaging around 90,000 tracks a day in June — a milestone showing generative-AI tools now out-produce human uploads on a major platform. Deezer is purging AI tracks tied to stream fraud or left unplayed for six months.

items.title: Talk to Spotify: what AI chatbots mean for music marketing
items.excerpt: Spotify's new conversational 'Talk to Spotify' assistant replaces passive algorithmic discovery with prompt-based, interactive listening — reshaping how artists and marketers earn attention, making metadata and storytelling as pivotal as editorial-playlist placement.
